prompt: Challenge C126-CH1: Our LiDAR point clouds for urban areas are enormous — a single city-block survey runs to 80 GB — and clients want classified, feature-extrac

content.text:
Let me analyze the challenge: need to build a faster automated pipeline for LiDAR point cloud processing (parallelizing LAStools/PDAL steps) or a cost model for burst cloud compute, to achieve 36-48 hour turnaround on 80-120 GB datasets.

Core work: Build/design a parallelized processing pipeline or cloud cost model for large urban LiDAR datasets.

R0965 (Anja Bošković): Has directly relevant work - tile-parallel GPU processing (SYN-PUB-10122), benchmarking on cloud vs GPU cluster (SYN-PUB-01555). This is exactly the work needed. can_do.
Checking the others: R0481 (Paunović) covers road infrastructure change detection, not pipeline parallelization, so cannot. R0923 (Sonja Bošković) handles urban point cloud segmentation and building footprints, which partly fits the classification side but misses the parallel architecture piece. R0765 (Stanković) is satellite/agricultural remote sensing, entirely the wrong domain. R0977 (Vlaisavljević) does LiDAR processing for infrastructure and scan-to-BIM, which partly applies since they know LiDAR workflows but lack the cloud/parallelization expertise.
